item.title: Splat 1.0.13
item.description:
Splat 1.0.13 replaces 1.0.12 with the same changes and is the version that goes to the Mac App Store.
- **Splat now runs in the App Sandbox**, as apps from the Mac App Store do: it reaches only the documents you open and the folders you grant. For the pictures, notes and Git data next to a document, the bar above the preview offers **Grant Access to Folder…**, and Splat keeps that access, also after a restart. - Your settings and unsaved texts come along on the first launch. **Open Recent** starts empty once; opening a document adds it again. - **Images from the web load without asking**, from any host, as soon as a document shows them. Like images in an email, they tell their servers that and when the document is opened. - An embed no longer follows a link out of the document's folder, and a bibliography outside the folder or its repository stays out of exports and printing. - A source over 1 MB colours what shows at once and the rest in steps, so the window answers right away. - The disk image shows its background sharp on Retina screens.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/issues/new/choose).
